The designed HEA is synthesized by arc melting of an element mixture with a purity higher than 99.9 % in a high-purity argon atmosphere. To ensure the uniformity of chemical composition, the melting process of each ingot is repeated five times.
The obtained ingot is homogenized at 1150 ◦C for 2 h
water quenched to room temperature
hot-rolled at 900 ◦C with a total reduction rate of 70 %
The hot-rolled sheet is recrystallized at 1150 ◦C for 3 h and then air-cooled to room temperature.
The samples for subsequent testing are all processed by electrical discharge wire cutting.
